title: Partner dependency unconfirmed with no alternative
thresholds_source: docs/decisions/risk-thresholds.md — D-M-RISK-3 + AI-1; activated by ADR-0057
notes: risk-thresholds.md AI-1 - the brownfield counterpart of greenfield-screening's criterion of the same name. Predicate is the D-M-RISK-3 conjunction verbatim ('no alternative' = fewer than two active candidates: status in {contacted, in_negotiation, signed}; dependency = the max-severity aggregation reading high). Same evidence as the graded amber rule risk-dd-partner-sourcing - D-M-RISK-3's 'both, non-competing' boundary: the graded signal fires at pre_fs, this kill path marks the case conditional at the DD exit; the kill action is never weakened by the graded signal and never substitutes for it. action mirrors the greenfield original (mark_conditional). Activated by ADR-0057 together with the db/lib/kill-criteria.ts evaluator: enabled=true with policy_id + thresholds_source satisfies the anti-tamper gate (registry check c), and the evaluator enforces the same gate at runtime.
